description: This file defines custom logging classes for PySpark, including a JSON formatter and a structured logger, with extensive documentation and example usage.

classes.name: JSONFormatter
classes.description: Custom JSON formatter for logging records, converting log records into JSON with detailed exception and stack trace info.

classes.name: PySparkLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class extending Python's logging.Logger, providing structured JSON logging tailored for PySpark applications.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PySparkLogger with the specified name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Overrides the addHandler method to set a JSON formatter on the handler before adding.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a message with level DEBUG in structured JSON format.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs a message with level INFO in structured JSON format.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs a message with level WARNING in structured JSON format.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a message with level WARN (if Python version < 3.13) in structured JSON format.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs a message with level ERROR in structured JSON format.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an ERROR message with exception info in structured JSON format.

methods.name: critical
methods.description: Logs a message with level CRITICAL in structured JSON format.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified level in structured JSON format.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Internal method to log messages with extra context in structured JSON format.
